rows.text: The Election Commission's notification of 10 June 1992 recites that the term of office of Shri R. Venkataraman, President of India, is due to expire on 24 July 1992, and that the election must be completed in time for the President elected to enter upon his office on 25 July 1992.

locator.item: Election Commission of India, Notification, New Delhi, the 10th June, 1992, O.N. 49(E), first and second recitals

rows.text: By the same notification (No. 479/92) the Election Commission appoints 24 June 1992 as the last date for nominations, 25 June for scrutiny, 27 June for withdrawals and Monday 13 July 1992 as the poll date, if a poll is necessary.

locator.item: O.N. 49(E), operative paragraph (a)-(d), signed K.P.G. Kutty, Secretary
